ruleInterpretations: Dianhu permanently records the actual chosen other living target at actual GameStart; each actual owner-caused positive damage occurrence draws one, regardless of damage amount. Actual positive recovery of that recorded target also draws one through its native HP change; zero clamped recovery does not qualify.

Relation state is frozen private CharacterState rules state. Future events require the original runtime source still enabled and owner alive. Target death stops future qualification, but the already-captured actual damage occurrence remains available if that same damage kills the target before AfterDamage. No character-specific source-loss/multi-source FAQ has been verified.

Jianji first pays one real draw to its selected other actor and drains native gain/HP/death/source-loss children. The recipient privately chooses a legal native use or decline for only that actual entity still in its hand; another hand card or a replacement draw cannot substitute. Already paid draw/recipient choice/native child may continue after giver skill loss/death, once, using exact source/hash/phase/movement invoice.

The native BuildLegalActions to ExecuteAction path preserves real actor/provider, output kind, physical entity, distance/targets/prohibitions and all native card effects. Recast is not use and is excluded. Dodge/Nullification without an active legal response-use window are not invented as proactive actions. Actual single-entity conversions may use their real native source, while multi/all-material conversions cannot consume unrelated cards.

Ordinary off-turn Slash use does not borrow or change the giver current Play quota. Ordinary alcohol uses exact actual-turn native commitment facts rather than the stale actor previous-own-turn boolean; dying alcohol uses Recovery and does not count ordinary alcohol quota. Native nullified ordinary use is still committed. A foreign Jianji alcohol effect expires at this actual giver turn end. The new alcohol facts are gated on catalog capability 24002, preserving old catalogs without that operation.

Native declaration support is a separate exact owning bridge in GameEngine.JianjiDeclarations.cs and HuangQuanDeclarationChecks.cs owned by root/A: same drawn entity goes Hand to Processing once, successful validation binds the actual native Use, failed validation returns the original paid request once. Root has integrated that bridge and removed the temporary candidate filter. Its independent native declaration success and challenged-failure check passed in the linked root focused and routine scopes.

Public draw-payment fact exposes count and movement bounds only. Unknown drawn IDs stay on trusted owning frame and native private movement; used cards become public only through actual native Use. LegalAction nested collections on pending receipts and committed use-issued/returned facts are deeply frozen.
